title: Rudradaman I
hook: Rudradaman I: Junagadh abhilekh ka nirmata
exam_points: Junagadh (Girnar) shilalekh (150 CE): lamba shuddh Sanskrit abhilekh.
Sudarshana jheel ki marammat karwayi; ye jheel Chandragupta Maurya ke samay ban chuki thi.
Dakshinapatha-pati Satakarni ko haraya par rishtedari ke karan nasht nahi kiya.

mcqs.q: Junagadh shilalekh kis shasak ka hai?
